parkour_skill_description: Running along walls, kicking off them, running up them, pulling yourself up onto ledges and rolling as you land. Longer and faster wall runs, more wall jumps in a row, higher climbs, softer landings and less stamina for every move. From skill 0 to 100: wall runs of {run0} to {run100} s, {kicks0} to {kicks100} wall jumps in a row, climbs of {climb0} to {climb100} m, and landing rolls safe from falls of {roll0} to {roll100} m.
parkour_hint_wallrun: Wall run! Jump to kick off the wall.
parkour_hint_climb: Running up the wall: hold forward to catch the top.
parkour_hint_hang: On the ledge: let go of forward and press it again, or jump, to pull yourself up; look away and jump to kick off; A/D to move along it; crouch or backward to let go.
parkour_hint_hang_vault: On the ledge: vault up with Just Vault's key, jump to kick off, crouch or backward to let go.
parkour_hint_hang_kick: On the ledge: jump to kick off, crouch or backward to let go.
parkour_hint_roll: Press crouch just before you land to roll and take less fall damage.
parkour_autoroll_unlocked: Parkour: from now on you roll by yourself when you land hard moving forward.
parkour_hint_shimmy: Left or right moves you along the edge.
parkour_hint_slide: Slide! Hold crouch to keep sliding, jump to leap out with its speed.
parkour_hint_landing_slide: Crouch just before landing from a low jump to land in a slide.
